description: A searchable catalog of Anthropic Skills, MCP servers, and Claude capabilities — designed as a reference index that Claude itself can query to validate and select skills/tools for any given task. Covers: 17 official Anthropic Skills, 7 MCP reference servers, 2,021 MCP servers from awesome-mcp-servers, 8 major marketplaces (Smithery, Claude Marketplaces, Skills Directory, SkillsMP, etc.), plus native Claude capabilities (tool use, vision, prompt caching, extended thinking, computer use, Claude Code, Claude.ai features).
topic: Full list + details of original (Anthropic pre-built) and user-built (custom/community) Skills for Claude: SKILL.md format, progressive disclosure, integration across Claude.ai / Claude Code / API, best practices.
